theorem_title: Extended cardinality equals the filtered domain count
natural_language_statement:
Let $S:\mathbb N\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be any membership predicate. Let $D$ be the source list enumerating 1 through 734, and let $c(S)$ count the selected entries from 1 through 732. Define $c_{734}(S)=c(S)+\mathbf{1}_{S(733)}+\mathbf{1}_{S(734)}$. Then

$$
c_{734}(S)=\bigl|[x\in D:S(x)=\mathrm{true}]\bigr|.
$$

This identity connects the arithmetic counting function to filtering an explicit domain. It holds for every predicate, without an admissibility or support hypothesis.
